newsitem.title: PERU: Peru net intl reserves fell to $8.401 bln Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: Peru net intl reserves fell to $8.401 bln Nov 19.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Monday its net international reserves fell to $8.401 billion on November 19 from $8.447 billion the week before.
The bank's foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short- and long-term debt obligations, was $1.606 billion on November 19.
President Alberto Fujimori said earlier this month the government expected Peru's international reserves to rise above $10 billion by mid-1998.
